name: zero-mem
description: zero-mem is a zero-token memory retrieval plugin for Pi, the coding agent. It stores and retrieves project memory without consuming any tokens from the agent's context window — memory lives outside the conversation and is injected only when relevant. The project is TypeScript-based and targets the growing group of users who want agent memory without paying the token cost.
highlights: Memory retrieval that costs zero context-window tokens
Designed for Pi, the coding agent
Injects memory only when relevant instead of bloating every call
Early but precisely aimed at a real pain point
curatorNote: Agent memory usually costs context; zero-mem inverts that by keeping memory outside the window and injecting on demand. 1 star, but the idea is exactly where agent ergonomics are heading.
